title: Usaghade language
description: Lower Cross River language of Cameroon and Nigeria
extract: Usaghade, Isanguele or Isangele is a small Lower Cross River language spoken in the southwestern region of southern Cameroon, with some speakers across the border in Cross River State, Nigeria.
